title: rk.universe
text: Ultimate RKWard GUI Ecosystem Meta-Package rk.universe master meta-package (inspired tidyverse philosophy) designed easily install, load, synchronize massive suite 70+ RKWard GUI plugins. installing single package, transform RKWard complete, state---art graphical environment data science, statistical modeling, academic publishing. Instead installing activating dozens plugins individually, rk.universe handles dependencies seamlessly integrates every graphical menu RKWard interface single command.

title: rk.universe
text: One-Line Installation: Pulls 70 highly specialized GUI plugins directly R-Universe servers. Automatic GUI Registration: Features smart .onAttach hook. loaded inside RKWard, automatically searches registers every .pluginmap file ecosystem. manual XML configuration required. Clean Console Output: Uses cli package print beautiful, non-obtrusive summary loaded tools activated menus attaching suite. Comprehensive Toolset: Equips RKWard tools ranging basic data wrangling (dplyr wrappers) advanced structural equation modeling (lavaan), complex survey analysis (srvyr), professional reporting (quarto & flextable).

title: rk.universe
text: rk.universe ecosystem covers almost every stage data science workflow. core plugin suites included : Data Import & Wrangling: rk.haven, rk.ddi.import, rk.subset.tidy, rk.dplyr, rk.tidyr, rk.data.wrangling, rk.janitor Complex Surveys & Psychometrics: rk.survey.design, rk.survey.wrangling, rk.efa, rk.psych Statistical Modeling: rk.bayesian, rk.lavaan, rk.weibull, rk.survival Data Visualization & Mapping: rk.ggsurvey, rk.gganimate, rk.cartographr, rk.map.globalities Academic Reporting & Tables: rk.quarto, rk.flextable, rk.gtsummary, rk.ctables, rk.codebook …dozens !

title: rk.universe
text: package orchestrates vast ecosystem, hosted R-Universe. install entire suite, simply add custom repository R options run install.packages() directly RKWard console:
code: # 1. Enable the AlfCano R-Universe repository options(repos = c(   alfcano = "https://alfcano.r-universe.dev",   CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org" ))  # 2. Install the meta-package (This will download all 70+ plugins automatically) install.packages("rk.universe")
